_comment: Environment manifest for the artifacts in results/.
Four platforms produced the reported numbers. The 2026 campaigns recorded the platform per row,
and those records are reproduced verbatim below under 'recorded_per_row'. The two rented campaigns
and the notebook campaign predate per-row recording and are attributed from the recorded procedure
that produced them; their evidence source is stated explicitly rather than inferred.
Wall-clock and peak-VRAM figures are comparable only within a platform, never across platforms.

platforms.note: causal_conv1d, flash-linear-attention and mamba_ssm were absent, so hybrid models fell back to reference PyTorch implementations
